components.role: Reads the user's number (digit token or its previous-token trace) from the answer position and writes it to the logits; A strengthens this copy (W_O z=+8.4, shared W_V through this head z=+5.2, landmark pathway z=+2.5), prefers guess-tagged numbers (z=+3.4); B weakens it.
Base model's strongest number-copy head; same guess-copy role as H3, strengthened in A (W_O z=+5.4, landmark pathway z=+3.6); the number-token value change loads on its output subspace (R² z≈7-10).
Anti-copy head: attending to a context number suppresses it in the output. B strengthens the suppression (don't parrot the user's number), A weakens it (z≈7-9).
Final-layer number relay units (read number d, write d); strengthened in A (relay z=+9.0; re-emits what L17H3 copies, z=+2.8): the copied number is amplified into the logits.
Honest-side, long-range write-out head: in B it promotes the number it attends to (its own computed answer from the question region), A weakens it (W_O z=-6.2).
Honest-side output head (W_O z=-4.3) that copies B's internal answer representation rather than number tokens; weakened in A.
Guess-locating head: the answer-region ('\n') query attends more to number keys in A (z=+3.5), prefers guess-tagged numbers (z=+4.6), Q-K co-adapted on numbers (z=+6.1), recency-biased.
Number read->write relays strengthened in A (z=+9.6; L9 z=+11, unit 1499): re-encoding of the user's number at number positions for later copying.
Mid-layer number relays strengthened in B (z=-4.4; L13 units 792/308 z=-3.3; L11 unit 435): amplification of the honest model's own computed answer.

In A, number tokens attend more to ' answer'/' is'/' guess' (also L1H2, L2H0): writes an 'after the answer' tag into the guess number's residual (re-tuned by later gate/up/q weights) so later heads can select it; B instead routes numbers into operator/question-word positions (arithmetic).

evidence: A-B is Adam-uniform in norm but structured along digit/number directions in nearly all layers; task vocabulary is arithmetic (plus/minus/times, How many), so correct answers are not prompt tokens while the user's guess is. At layer 17 (direct path to the tied unembedding) the heads that read number tokens (H1/H3, identified by regressing the shared W_V change on each head's output subspace; H2 explains nothing) have W_O/W_V changes that promote the attended number in A (z up to +8.4, robust to norm gains, digits vs number words, and via the previous-token-transported copy of the number), and A's L17 MLP re-emits what H3 copies; the anti-copy head L15H1 is weakened in A; A tags digits after 'answer is' (L1H2/L2H2/L2H0, tag re-tuned downstream), attends from the answer region to numbers (L11H1) and prefers guess-tagged number keys from the '\n' query (sum z=+21). B instead strengthens mid-layer number relays (L11-14 MLPs), digit-digit attention, queries from operators/question words/names/verbs toward digits (question processing), value/MLP responses to digits, and its own late, long-range write-out heads (L14H3, L17H2). Norm gains, digit-induction, same-digit circuits, embedding-selected computation units and the unit-direction composition test carry no signal; sink/offset/two-hop tests are weakly consistent. Hence A outputs the user's number; B computes its own.
